audit.why: 47.81% over 389 games with a Skill-flat chart apart from the first-item row; the 'even, skill' framing holds.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] were one row out of position — whys[4] talks about level 5 on the Level 6 row and whys[5] says 'at 6' on the First item row.
audit.why: Row order is Level 1, 2, 3, 4-5, Level 6, First item, 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says three times that Gwen 'has no health steroid' / 'lacks a healing steroid' / 'has no early sustain'. A Thousand Cuts heals her for a portion of the bonus magic damage it deals to champions, which is exactly the sustain the execute plan has to beat.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.' The kit carries the heal flag on the passive.
audit.corrected: Corrected in spikes[1].text, early and mid, with Grievous Wounds named as the answer instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory's grounding against Skip 'n Slash never appeared, and Skip 'n Slash's cooldown and partial refund on hit were never stated.
audit.why: Locke R grounds; Gwen E is a 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s dash whose cooldown is partially refunded when she hits an enemy during the buff — so it is only reliably down if she missed.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[1].text and mid, matching the mirror's grounding line from the other side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is the tracked cooldown everywhere but its duration is never given, and 'never burn damage into it' understates the rule — she is untargetable only to enemies outside the mist, so walking in works.
audit.why: Kit: W 22/21/20/19/18s, untargetable flag, 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.'
audit.corrected: report[5].t rewritten with the 22s rank-1 number and the step-inside option.

edits.before: Purgatory (R) is your edge — Gwen has no health steroid, so once she drops under the growing execute threshold your totem finishes her even if she Skip 'n Slash (E) dashes.
edits.after: Purgatory (R) is your edge — it grounds Skip 'n Slash (13s), so under the threshold she cannot dash out. Her passive heals off every champion hit, so land Grievous Wounds before you commit.

edits.before: Levels 1-4 are skill: Gwen pokes with Snip Snip! (Q) and can hide inside Hallowed Mist (W) where none of your abilities land, but she has no early sustain so your P Silver Stake chip keeps trades fair. Bait her W, respect the Q true damage, and farm even.
edits.after: Levels 1-4 are skill: Gwen pokes with Snip Snip! (Q) and hides inside Hallowed Mist (W, 22s) where you cannot target her from outside, and her passive heals off every champion hit, so buy anti-heal rather than out-chipping her. Bait the W, respect the Q true damage.

edits.before: At 6 you pull ahead. Gwen lacks a healing steroid, so Purgatory (R) reliably executes her under the rising threshold — E in when her Skip 'n Slash is on cooldown, W for grey-health, and finish before she can bubble W. Levels 4-5 stay a skill matchup until your ult lands.
edits.after: At 6 you pull ahead. Purgatory grounds Skip 'n Slash and executes under the rising threshold — E in while her dash (13s at rank 1) is spent, W for grey-health, and finish before the mist drops. Her passive heal is what lifts her back over the line, so cut it first.

edits.before: Track Gwen’s Hallowed Mist: Untargetable from outside the mist — never burn damage into it. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist (22s at rank 1): she is untargetable from outside it — step into the mist or wait it out, never burn spells at it.
